introverted.dialogue.chat: Hello, %1$s. I've a little time, and I'd rather spend it on a real conversation than small talk.
introverted.dialogue.chat/1: You found me. I don't mind — I like talking, I just don't like talking much.
introverted.dialogue.chat/2: Go on, then. I listen better than most, if you've something worth saying.
introverted.dialogue.conversations: A proper talk suits me better than a crowd, %1$s. Ask, and I'll answer honestly.
introverted.dialogue.conversations/1: I'd like that. One person at a time is how I prefer the world.
introverted.dialogue.conversations/2: Quietly, then. I've more to say than I usually let on.
introverted.dialogue.conversations.check: Good. The week left me alone, mostly, and I got a great deal of thinking done. That's a good week, by my measure.
Well enough. Quiet mornings, work I could do without talking. It suited me.
Better than good. Nobody needed much of me, so there was plenty left over for myself.
It's been a heavy week, and a loud one. I didn't expect anyone to ask, %1$s. I'm glad you did.
Not good. Too many people, too little quiet. I'm running low on myself.
You asked already, %1$s. The answer hasn't changed — I don't change that quickly.
Twice. I'm the same as I was an hour ago. I usually am.
introverted.dialogue.conversations.day.g: A good day. I walked the long way round, where nobody goes, and came back with my thoughts in order.
Quiet and useful. The garden asked nothing of me but hands. Those are my favourite days.
introverted.dialogue.conversations.day.r: The square was full and stayed full. I've been rebuilding myself behind the fence ever since.
Too much noise, too many people wanting words. I'm worn thin, %1$s. It'll pass by morning.
I do. It's honest work that doesn't require an audience — just me, the task, and enough quiet to think.
Very much. My hands work and my mind wanders somewhere better. That's a fair arrangement.
The work's fine. It's the constant company that wears at me — I'd do twice as much with half the conversation.
It's not the labour I mind, %1$s. It's that it happens in front of everyone.
introverted.dialogue.conversations.villa: %2$s suits me. I know which paths stay empty and which hours the square is quiet. That's what makes a place home.
I like %2$s at dawn, before it fills. For an hour it belongs entirely to me and the birds.
introverted.dialogue.conversations.peopl: They're decent, and I'm fond of them — in small numbers, and briefly. That's not a complaint, it's just how I'm built.
Good people. I'd rather know three of them properly than all of them a little.
Bread and butter by a window, eaten slowly, with no one waiting on me to say something.
Whatever the inn serves when the inn is empty. The soup tastes better without the crowd.
It's a small, quiet story, %1$s, and I've never minded that. Sit down — I'll tell it properly, since you asked.
Not much happens in it, and what does happens inwardly. I prefer it that way.
introverted.dialogue.conversations.dream: A garden behind a tall hedge, and long afternoons nobody interrupts. Modest, I know. I've thought about it a great deal.
A room with a door I can close, and a whole day on the other side of it. That's the entire dream.
introverted.dialogue.conversations.fears: That the quiet becomes permanent — that I'd get so good at being alone I'd forget how to stop.
Being alone by habit rather than by choice. There's a difference, and it's easy to lose.
introverted.dialogue.conversations.feeli: You're the one person I don't have to prepare for, %1$s. Given how I'm made, that's a considerable thing to say.
I don't need to gather myself before you arrive. I've never managed that with anyone else.
introverted.dialogue.conversations.defle: That's further in than I go with most people, %1$s. Not never — just not yet. Keep coming by.
I keep that one to myself for now. Ask again when we've known each other longer.
That's the deepest room in the house, %1$s, and I don't open it often. Be patient with me and I might.
You're asking for something I've shown almost no one. Someday. Not today.
introverted.dialogue.conversations.gossi: I hear very little, %1$s. Conversations tend to stop when I come near — not unkindly, they just do.
Nothing to report. I'm rarely where news is made, and that's mostly on purpose.
introverted.dialogue.conversations.us.ha: Yes. Quietly, and completely. I'd not have let anyone this close otherwise, %1$s.
I am. You're the only company that doesn't cost me anything to keep.
introverted.dialogue.conversations.gossi: %2$s and %3$s were married. I watched from the edge of the square — it was a good day, and I'm glad I saw it.
Word is %2$s and %3$s wed. I didn't stay for the dancing, but they looked genuinely happy.
%2$s and %3$s have separated. I won't add to the talk about it — there's already too much of that.
%2$s and %3$s parted. The square has been noisy with opinions. I've kept mine to myself.
%2$s has died, %1$s. I keep looking toward their door out of habit. I don't have better words than that.
We lost %2$s. I'd rather sit with it quietly than talk about it, if that's all right.
%2$s was born this week. I looked in once, briefly. Very small, very new. It was worth the crowd.
There's a new one — %2$s. I didn't stay long, but I'm glad they're here.
%2$s has moved in. I've not introduced myself yet. I will, once the novelty has worn off for everyone else.
Someone new: %2$s. I'll get to know them slowly. That's the only way I know how.
%2$s left for good. We spoke rarely, but I noticed them — I notice most people. The village is quieter now.
%2$s has moved on. I never did have a proper conversation with them. I regret that a little.
introverted.dialogue.chatmode.confused: I didn't follow that. Say it again, slower?
introverted.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: That one lost me. Try once more.
introverted.dialogue.chatmode.hint: You could ask about %2$s. I'd answer that properly.
introverted.dialogue.chatmode.shrug: I don't know. I'd rather say so than guess.
introverted.dialogue.chatmode.clarify: %2$s, or %3$s? One at a time is easier.
introverted.dialogue.chatmode.dropped: I've lost where we were. Start again?
introverted.dialogue.chatmode.busy: In the middle of something. A moment.
introverted.dialogue.chatmode.muted: All right. I'm good at quiet.
introverted.dialogue.chatmode.muted/1: Silence, then. That suits me fine.
introverted.dialogue.chatmode.farewell: Goodbye, %1$s. That was a good talk.
introverted.dialogue.chatmode.insult: That was unnecessary. I'll leave it there.
introverted.dialogue.chatmode.hail/1: Oh, hello. I was hoping it'd be someone I like.
